results.title: Jon Rahm could be set to leave LIV Golf, pay massive penalties to return to PGA Tour in matter of weeks
results.description: Jon Rahm has reportedly made a deal to return to the PGA Tour within weeks, facing a $25 million fine donated to charity and an apology tour.

results.title: Little League Classic Boosts South Williamsport
results.description: The Little League Classic is scheduled for August 23, 2026, at Historic Bowman Field in Williamsport, Pennsylvania, with the Milwaukee Brewers facing the Atlanta Braves, according to MLB event information . Its timing is central to the community story: the game falls inside the Little League Baseball® World Series window, which runs from August 19 to August 30, 2026, in South Williamsport, Pennsylvania.
